items.text: Atwanare a Lasaro
Todyakakin ecekile ŋolo anyaritae Lasaro ŋolo alo Betania, alore a Maria ka nakaato keŋ Marita.
(Arae Maria na ŋina eosakini akimyet ŋina akukunyon nakejen a Yesu, ido toninaiya a ŋitim keŋ. Lokaato keŋ Lasaro iŋes adyaka).
Apotu ŋakaitotoi keŋ kiyakiyasi ŋakiro neni a Yesu temasi, “Ekapolon, edyak lokone kon!”
Ani iirari Yesu ŋakiro ŋun, tolimu tema, “Ekaku, nyerae edeke ŋol ŋolo aaran, nai erae ŋolo itoodiuni apolou ŋina ka Akuj ka ikotere etakanunia apolou ŋina a Lokoku ka Akuj.”
Amina Yesu Marita ka Maria ta lokaato kec Lasaro.
Kedau iŋes tari akiirar atemar edyak Lasaro, kiriya nabo ŋirwa ŋiarei aneni alimokinere.
Ani ekaku, tolimok ŋikasyomak keŋ tema, “Apena oboŋosi Yudeya.”
Toboŋokis ŋikasyomak temasi, “Eketataman, ŋirwa ŋulupei ŋoon lu, acamito Ŋiyudayan akimas iyoŋ a ŋamoru, icamit nabo iyoŋ aboŋor inaa a?”
Toboŋok Yesu ikes tema, “Nyerae mono ŋisaae ŋulu ka apaaran ŋitomon ka ŋiarei a? Ani elosi ituŋanan naparan, nyigukini, anerae ite iŋes akica ŋina ka akwap a na.
Ani elosi ituŋanan nakwaare, igukini, anerae emam akica aneni keŋ.”
Tolimok nabo ikes tema, “Ejotoe lokone yok Lasaro, alosi ayoŋ akitekienyun iŋes.”
Tolimokis ŋikasyomak iŋes temasi, “Ani kejotoe iŋes, Ekapolon, eŋaleuni.”
Erworo Yesu atemar atwana Lasaro, nai abasi ikes kori ejotoe kire.
Aŋun, kisileerek Yesu ikes tema, “Adau Lasaro atwanare,
nai aŋuna kus, alakara ayoŋ aŋuna pa ikirukitor ayoŋ ka iŋes, ikotere iyes inupyata. Nai apena oanyutu iŋes.”
Abu Tomas (ŋolo anyaritae Emuut) tolimok ŋikasyomak ŋuluce tema, “Apena iwon daŋ orukosi ka Eketataman, otwaka kaapei.”
Yesu iŋes erae ayarun ka akiyar
Ani edoluni Yesu, toryamu Lasaro kenuki ka kelunyar daŋ ŋirwa ŋiomwon.
Aapikina Betania ka Yerusalem, arae ŋakilomitae ŋauni,
ido aponito Ŋiyudayan akimaima Marita ka Maria aŋuna ka atwanare a lokaato kec.
Ani iirari Marita atemar ebunit Yesu, tolot akisiryam iŋes, nai edoŋit Maria kai.
Tolimok Marita Yesu tema, “Ekapolon, kerae toyai iyoŋ nege, pa ketwanit lokaato kaŋ.
Nai tokona daŋ ayeni atemar, epedori Akuj ainakin iyoŋ ibore daadaŋ ŋini iŋita iyoŋ.”
Tolimok Yesu iŋes tema, “Eyaruni lokaato kon!”
Tolimok Marita iŋes tema, “Ayeni ayoŋ atemar iteyarunio iŋes Akoloŋit ŋina esidyon.”
Tolimok Yesu iŋes tema, “Arae Ayoŋ ayarun ka akiyar, ŋinituŋanan akanupi ayoŋ, eyaruni tari ketwana daŋ.
Nabo ŋini eyari, okonupite ayoŋ, nyetwani jik. Inupit iyoŋ nu a?”
Tolimok Marita iŋes tema, “Ee, Ekapolon, anup ayoŋ atemar irae iyoŋ Kristo, Lokoku ka Akuj, ŋolo etemokino bu nakwap.”
Kigwor Yesu aŋuna a Lasaro
Ani kedau Marita alimun ŋun, tolot neni a nakaato keŋ Maria, tolimok aneni keŋ bon tema, “Eyai Eketataman nege, ikinyarit iyoŋ.”
Ani iirari Maria ŋakiro ŋun, tonyou atipei, tolot neni a Yesu.
(Ariŋa Yesu nyelomuna lore, ayai neni kisiryamia Marita iŋes.)
Ani iŋolikinete Ŋiyudayan ŋulu emaimayete Maria alokai iŋes enyouni atipei, totupakis iŋes ebasi kori elosi iŋes nalyal akigworo.
Todol nai Maria neni ayai Yesu, toryedik alokiŋaren keŋ, tolimok iŋes tema, “Okoe Ekapolon, kerae toyai iyoŋ nege, pa ketwanit lokaato kaŋ.”
Ani iŋolikini Yesu Maria igworo ka igworosi tari Ŋiyudayan ŋulu arukito ka iŋes, tonomosi iŋes ŋakiro etau, kiyaloloŋ,
kiŋit ikes tema, “Ai inukakis iyes iŋes?” Tolimokis ikes iŋes temasi, “Ekapolon, bua toanyu.”
Kigwor Yesu.
Temasi Ŋiyudayan, “Kiŋolikisi, kemina iŋes Lasaro!”
Nai temasi ŋice, “Okoe, abu iŋes kitekienyu emudukanot! Pa mono kepedorit iŋes akiretakin atwanare a Lasaro a?”
Kiteyarunae Lasaro
Tolot nai Yesu nalyal emarani ekeetau nooi. Arae alyal aturukan, togolokinitetei amoru lopuke.
Tolimok Yesu ikes tema, “Tolemasi amoru alopuke.”
Tolimok Marita, nakaato keŋ ke ekatwan Yesu tema, “Ekapolon, abosu tokona iŋes, anerae adau akiriya analyal ŋirwa ŋiomwon.”
Tolimok Yesu iŋes tema, “Pa akalimokinit ayoŋ iyoŋ atemar ani kinup, iŋolikini apolou ŋina ka Akuj a?”
Tolemasi nai ikes amoru analyal. Kireo Yesu kidiama nakuj tema, “Alakara ayoŋ neni kon Papa, anerae ikiira iyoŋ ayoŋ.
Ayeni ayoŋ atemar ikiiranari iyoŋ ayoŋ jwi jwi; nai alimunit ayoŋ ŋakiro nu, ikotere tonupyata ŋituŋa lu ŋulu ewuasi a nege daadaŋ atemar, iyoŋ kire ikiyakit ayoŋ.”
Kedau alimun ŋun, tocelu nooi tema, “Lasaro! Tolomu kiŋa!”
Tolomu ekatwan ŋol analyal, ilogilogakinitae ŋanaŋgae ŋuna nuket nakejen ka nakan keŋ; ereet daŋ aenen. Tolimok nai Yesu ikes tema, “Tolacasi ŋanaŋgae, toesikis tolot.”
Totukut ŋituŋa akiar Yesu
Aŋun, apotu Ŋiyudayan ŋulu alalak ŋulu arukunete ka Maria, ido kiŋolikis ŋuna etiyae Yesu, tonupa iŋes.
Nai apotu ŋice alokidiŋ kec toloto neni a Ŋiparisayon, tolimokis ŋuna abu Yesu kitiya.
Tocunakinos nai ŋisacaradotin ŋulu apolok ka Ŋiparisayon Natukot kec temasi, “Okoe, ikikokini ai? Kire itiyae ekile lo ŋakujuwuanisya ŋuna alalak.
Ani kikilakak iwon iŋes itiyae jik ikona, epote ŋituŋa daadaŋ akiwuapakin iŋes, potu nai Ŋiromanin akinyasun Akai ka Akuj kaapei ka akwap yok.”
Nai abu epei alokidiŋ kec ŋolo anyaritae Kaipa, ŋolo arae Esacaradoti ŋolo Apolon nooi alokaru a ŋol tema, “Emam ibore iyenete iyes ipei daŋ!
Nyiyenete iyes atemar ejok epeikile totwan aŋuna a ŋituŋa akilo abukor akwap daadaŋ a?”
Nyelimuno iŋes ŋakiro nu erae ŋuna keŋ, nai aŋuna araakar iŋes Esacaradoti ŋolo Apolon nooi alokaru a ŋol, adwari iŋes atemar etwani Yesu aŋuna ka akwap a ŋina a Ŋiyudayan.
Meere aŋuna ka akwap a ŋin bon, nai ikotere ecunakini iwapei ŋidwe ŋulu ka Akuj, ŋulu ielara.
Ameun akoloŋit ŋin, totukut ikes epite ŋoloaret Yesu.
Aŋun, nyitor nabo Yesu nakwap a Ŋiyudayan ileere, nai tolot nakwap ŋina aapi analoŋisat, lotaun ŋolo anyaritae Epuraim, kiboiyoto ka ŋikeekasyomak aina.
Aapuunito ŋasuban ŋuna a Paska. Aponito Yerusalem ŋituŋa ŋulu alalak alorerya akiteseguno, ikwapei icikakinitotor Ŋikisila, eriŋa nyedolo Paska.
Ewarito ikes Yesu, kirworos ewuasi alo Kai ka Akuj ebasi, “Anu itamete iyes? Ebuni iŋes nasuban kori mam?”
Aris nai ŋisacaradotin ŋulu apolok ka Ŋiparisayon kicika ŋituŋa atemar, ani ŋini eyeni neni eyai Yesu, itemokino kitaanyu ikes, ikotere kikamunae iŋes.
